VBO:0201047.summary: Poochons pair a Bichon Frise with Toy or Miniature Poodle ancestry. Breeding approaches differ: Rolling Meadows describes producing first crosses only, while other breeders include Poochon-to-Poochon matings and backcrosses to a parent breed. The same name therefore covers several generations, rather than one fixed parental balance or temperament.
VBO:0201047.shortDescription: A Bichon Frise–Poodle cross spanning Toy and Miniature ancestry, first crosses, later matings and backcrosses.
